observations.text: Root https://seko.sensetime.com redirects a logged-in user to /explore. Account shows 110 credits (积分) in the top bar next to 开通会员.

Home hero is a single prompt composer with three modes (短片工作室 / 创作 Agent / 无限画布); the composer accepts a document upload (pdf/docx/txt) and has a model chip 'Seedance2.5 全能模式' and a '多剧集' (multi-episode) switch.
Community feed cards carry a '画布' badge for canvas-type works, implying published works can be either canvases or story videos.
The genre chips (出海短剧 / 短剧漫剧 / 知识分享 / 音乐 MV) are templates for the story-planning agent (短片工作室), matching the my-space 故事 category filters.
Promo banner: Seedance 2.5 普惠版 9积分/秒 — credits are charged per second for video generation.
